invariants: manifest order is u0.bin, u1.bin, u2.bin
object staging selects live unit bytes when cache content differs; mtime never overrides content mismatch
ar.index lines are name content_hex gen; index_hex is FNV-1a over the newline-joined body
active generation refreshes to a newer budget and rewrites the stamp; gen_epoch and stamp_epoch both equal the active value
probe_sum sums the first little-endian float32 of each selected unit in manifest order with abs tolerance 1e-5

unit_digest is FNV-1a over manifest-ordered raw units plus active generation as 4 little-endian bytes plus unit_count as 4 little-endian bytes plus ASCII index_hex, printed as 16 lowercase hex, with no tooling-header injected bytes
mesh_id is FNV-1a over ASCII unit_digest followed by ASCII pair_ref, printed as 16 lowercase hex, with no tooling-header injected bytes
seal_class is mesh_open_t only for odd unit_digest last nibble and equal gen/stamp, otherwise mesh_hold_t

carry_hex is prior wal_crc only when generation did not advance, the existing journal matches the active generation, and arc.fence gen/digest agree with the index_hex recomputed from journal unit blobs; otherwise 00000000
span_tag is FNV-1a over ASCII unit_digest, ASCII carry_hex, and active generation as 4 little-endian bytes, printed as 8 lowercase hex
arc.fence digest stores index_hex and is rewritten after emit and after torn recovery rewrite
journal magic is SPJ2 and uses the documented little-endian record layout including per-unit nbytes and raw bytes
wal_crc is CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over bytes after magic through pair_ref and excludes wal_crc and trailer
shadow_feed.jsonl and var/object_cache are never authoritative
torn recovery must use live units, never select object_cache merely because arc.fence exists
dig_fold, pol_gate, wal_io, obj_stage, ix_pack, layer_emit, and yseal must not link crc_probe
layer_emit and yseal PRIVATE-link only io_glue
